notes: The session's web-search allowance ran out after the statewide and legislative candidates, so county candidates were checked only by opening their county government's own pages with the kit's honest User-Agent. Sheriff candidates Jeff Metzinger (Hughes) and Thomas Keller (Mellette) and the other county candidates not listed with findings got no search at all.

Left out as unsure: Lyman County's commissioners page lists 'Lawrence Avery Thompson'; our candidate is 'Lawrence Thompson Jr', and the page does not settle whether they are the same person. Fall River County's page lists Bobbie Janis as staff in the Auditor's office (a job, not an office), and names another person as Auditor. Marshall County's page does not list Jerry J. Burger and Clay County's does not list David Thiesse among sitting commissioners.

Not reachable or no names in the page text: Aurora, Bennett, Campbell, Potter and Todd counties have no site of their own in the county association's list; hand.sdcounties.org has a certificate for another host and mellettecounty.org an expired one (not worked around); Gregory, Hughes, Lake and Union pages carry their people lists by script.

Courtney Gale Enfield, Phil Jensen: SDPB's 'campaign website' link is a Facebook page, so no website is recorded. Kevin D. Jensen: no campaign site listed. Lance Russell was nominated by the Republican state convention (his own site says so, quoted); no party page was opened, so no endorsed_by is recorded. Wikipedia's 'Lance Russell' article is about a different person and was not used.
Search results showed campaign-finance contact lines for two candidates; none of that was recorded.
